items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember if he took lessons from anybody? ... [INTERVIEWEE] He started out, when he left, way up in the company, he was rotating. I never knew I was doing no reading of it. I took out knowing or saw him reading.

ctx.x: And he could hear me playing over there and he'd tell Willie Humphrey, he'd tell the fellow, come down and say, he's going to bust a vessel in his neck. You see Willie Humphrey, anytime you meet him, just ask him that word. Him and I and Black Benny work together. Years, that he liked.
I've heard a lot of people talk about that. Well, what's more to get back to Johnny Dogg.
Do you remember if he took lessons from anybody? Did he ever? I don't know.
